rule: These directives supersede older PR descriptions, comments, tests, scheduler summaries and inferred policy whenever they conflict. Schedulers must not reinterpret an older artifact as newer authorization.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: These are PAPER hard ceilings/floors, not trade targets. The $125 fixed-dollar limit is binding even if a compatibility max_trade_fraction field is 1.0. Executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, queue/fill realism, adverse markout, uncertainty/capital-time economics, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch remain mandatory.

architecture.target: one unified V7 PAPER engine on main

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits/markouts are quantity-specific depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

current_priority_order: Stop policy regressions that remove the V7 $125 fixed trade cap or widen the 5%/15%/70% market/event/gross ceilings.
Validate and integrate the Graph/RV v3 executable dependence-robust successor under the authorized bounded PAPER envelope.
Validate and integrate runtime process-group draining so no proxy, recorder, broker or state-writer descendant survives its owner.
Rebase the HF event-time/depth-aware maker, causal-flow/depth-aware taker and hard-arb freshness successor onto the authorized bounded V7 policy without weakening executable economics.
Consolidate PCA, Local Factor, cross-sectional ranking, Micro Maker, Micro Taker, Graph/RV, hard arb and External Intelligence into the single V7 structure.
Create one fresh integration branch from current main, bind exact source SHA/provenance, merge to main only after deterministic and economic gates are satisfied.
Run exact-SHA CI, monitoring, live-paper, private single-writer and server-health validation; advance paper-validated and deploy the same SHA for continuous PAPER operation.
Only after the validated V7 deployment is healthy, delete superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 entrypoints, migration adapters, stale workflows, obsolete tests/configs and superseded research branches.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Report any scheduler/PR that conflicts with this directive; never recommend an older sizing artifact as current authorization.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Treat this file as the current operator authorization. Reject PRs that disable the V7 fixed-dollar cap, exceed $125/trade, or widen the V7 5%/15%/70% market/event/gross ceilings as an alleged operator requirement. Continue enforcing PAPER-only and authenticated-execution separation.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize Graph v3, runtime process-group drain, HF successors under the bounded V7 envelope, multi-frequency PCA/LF/ranking evidence, then external-intelligence integration.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Treat the authorized bounded V7 PAPER envelope as hard safety. Promotion remains evidence-gated by exact source provenance, executable costs, OOS evidence, stability, data health and drawdown controls.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Merge only the single canonical V7 integration consistent with $125/trade, 5%/15%/70% concentration/gross ceilings, PAPER-only and authenticated-disabled separation.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Preserve the current bounded operator directives and dispatch only the existing Promotion Controller after validator completion and the existing Integration Merge after a successful controller completion. Never merge, deploy, mutate paper-validated, reinterpret policy or execute orders directly.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Bind CI, monitoring and live-paper validation to the exact merged V7 SHA.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Enforce the current bounded V7 authorization in deterministic Release/Debug tests while preserving executable-price, depth, verified-fee, slippage, queue/fill, causality and statistical-inference tests.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate V7 per-strategy/frequency PnL, fills, markouts, queue/depth, process ownership and exact deployed revision.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Validate the unified V7 PAPER engine using public data; do not require arbitrary trade count by weakening economics; advance paper-validated only on exact-SHA success.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision and preserve PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify single writer/process ownership, recorder, broker, proxy, Grafana/metrics and deployed SHA; report rather than rewriting policy.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Continue prospective maker evidence across HF cadences with fill-conditioned PnL and bounded-delay depth-aware markouts; do not optimize fill count alone.
scheduler_assignments.v6-live-data-research: Compatibility evidence only. Do not expand V6 architecture or create new V6 production paths; migrate useful evidence/contracts into V7.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank challengers by executable OOS economics and incremental utility under the bounded V7 contracts; do not propose safety-envelope widening as alpha work.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate the current priority order in this file. Dispatch remediation/research only; never reinterpret stale PR text as current authorization.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Test multiple HF cadences with strict receive/exchange freshness, depth, fee, legging and unwind accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural/Graph opportunities under the v3 joint-state/fixed-horizon execution contract, not marginal-fill products or assumed terminal payout floors.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect, store and chronologically validate public information; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only connectivity only; no policy mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v6-market-cache-relay: Keep the compatibility cache fresh only; do not mutate V7 model policy or champion selection.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reopen, recreate or merge the superseded unbounded V7 policy: the current PAPER authorization requires the $125 fixed trade cap and forbids restoring 100% market/event/gross ceilings above 5%/15%/70%.
Do not use the superseded 100%/no-fixed-cap directive or older PR text as the current V7 sizing authority.
Do not delete legacy code before the unified V7 SHA is merged to main, validated, advanced to paper-validated and healthy on the PAPER server.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner or execution ledger.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside this repository except the existing private PAPER runtime/deployment/telemetry channels explicitly registered by the control plane.
